sentences.text: Shri Akhlesh Gupta, learned counsel for the appellant.
Shri B.N.Malhotra, learned counsel for respondent No. 3.

ORDER Assailing the award dated 23/4/2015 passed by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, District Gwalior in Claim Case No. 4/2015, on the point of inadequacy of the compensation, the appellant has preferred this appeal for enhancement of award under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, District Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The accident in question took place on 6/9/2012 in which the appellant sustained grievous injuries and fracture in right leg.

2. Appellant/claimant had filed the claim petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 seeking compensation to the tune of Rs. 8,50,000/- for the bodily injuries and fractures suffered by appellant/claimant in the accident which took place on 6/9/12.
However, Claims Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.47,337/- with interest at the rate of 7% per annum from the date of application.

3. Briefly stated facts of the case are that on 6/9/12 when appellant was returning from the house of her sister, it is alleged that rider of motorcycle NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:13651 2 MA-815-2015 bearing registration No. MP30MD9115 by driving the motorcycle in a rash and negligent manner dashed the appellant, due to which she sustained grievous injuries in her right leg,
back, left shoulder and other parts of body including fracture in right leg, therefore, she moved a claim petition.

Smt. Harjeet Kaur vs Harendra Singh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198300860/
1 4.

entities.text: Harjeet Kaur vs Harendra Singh on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Shri Gupta, learned counsel representing the appellant, contends that the injuries sustained by the appellant were grievous in nature.
The appellant suffered severe bodily injuries alongwith fracture in right leg and also she was operated and rod was inserted.
After the incident she could not work for long period.
After the accident she is not being able to do the work which she used to prior to the accident for her livelihood i.e. dairy work.
The Tribunal erred in disbelieving the disability caused to appellant.

The Tribunal has only awarded Rs. 47,337/- towards medical expenses, loss of income, grievous injury, Special diet and pain and suffering which is on the lower side, thus the compensation awarded by the learned Tribunal is inadequate, without looking to the nature of grievous injuries sustained, hospitalization and medical bills.

In view of the foregoing submissions,
the enhancement of the compensation so awarded by the Tribunal, has been prayed for.
5. On the other hand, Shri Malhotra, learned counsel representing the respondent/Insurance Company, supported the impugned award and prayed for dismissal of the appeal.

6. After having heard learned counsel appearing for the parties and on perusal of the pleadings and the evidence so adduced, in the opinion of this Court, considering the nature of injuries especially fracture sustained, treatment papers and its period, the mental pain and suffering and also the other heads, the compensation as awarded by the Claims Tribunal is liable NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-GWL:13651 3 MA-815-2015 to be enhanced by Rs. 10,000/- in lump sum thereby making the total compensation 57,337/-which shall be paid within two months from today.
7. In view of the forgoing discussions, the appeal succeeds and is hereby allowed in part.
The appellant is held entitled to receive the enhanced amount of Rs. 10,000/- in addition to the amount of compensation already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as per impugned award from the date of filing claim case.
The other conditions including liability of payment of compensation amount as imposed by claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
8. With the aforesaid modification in the impugned award, the appeal stands allowed in part.

(ROOPESH CHANDRA VARSHNEY) JUDGE JPS/-
JAI PRAKASH SOLANKI 2024.08.20 14:39:37 +05'30'
